name: Happy Hoppy Hopkins
subtitle: Funky Wet Hop Belgian IPA
description: First-runnings Belgian-style IPA brewed with freshly harvested whole-cone wet hops. Bright citrus aromatics with a tart, funky finish.
commercialIngredients: Water, Malted Barley, Whole-Cone Wet Hops, Yeast.

name: Wet Hop House Bitter
subtitle: 2nd Partigyle English Bitter
description: Crisp, sessionable second-runnings bitter with a biscuit malt backbone and fresh garden-hop bitterness.
commercialIngredients: Water, Malted Barley, Homegrown Fresh Wet Hops, Yeast.

name: Do Not Open Yet
subtitle: Vintage English Barleywine
description: A deeply layered barleywine built for long-term cellar aging with dark fig, treacle, and warming English hop bitterness.
commercialIngredients: Water, Malted Barley, Hops, Yeast, Priming Sugar.

name: Midlands
subtitle: English Strong Ale
description: Copper-amber English strong ale with toasted bread crust, orange marmalade, and a firm British hop backbone.

name: Wolfpack
subtitle: Smoked Amber Ale
description: A balanced smoked amber with campfire aromatics, caramel sweetness, and a clean, savory finish.
commercialIngredients: Water, Malted Barley (including Beechwood Smoked Malt), Hops, Yeast.
